source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify AMD CBS defaults against the platform SPEC and persistence of approved non-default controls without destabilizing CPU/fabric operation, memory training, NUMA/PCIe topology, power/thermal limits, boot or management recovery.
original_method: Manually load defaults and compare a named CBS matrix with SPEC, then apply bounded non-default values, save/reboot or cold boot as documented, visually verify persistence and correlate platform topology/health.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret vendor-specific CBS fields, operate the BIOS, load defaults, apply approved values and inspect persistence. Automated topology and health collection cannot perform or accept those firmware steps.
required_inputs: Board, CPU, BIOS and AGESA/CBS revision
Named CBS fields, dependencies and documented safe values
SPEC defaults and approved non-default matrix
Warm/cold reset requirement, console/BMC recovery and known-good baseline
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or infer values across different AGESA, CPU or memory populations.
Do not exceed project power/thermal limits or alter protection/training controls without exact vendor guidance.
Capture topology, memory-training and health baselines before Load Default.
Stop on training loops, topology loss, corrected/uncorrected hardware errors, thermal/power anomaly, boot failure or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only CPU/AGESA identity, memory/fabric/NUMA/PCIe topology, power/thermal telemetry, logs and BMC health.
Compare approved field effects across operator phases and identify regressions.
Do not drive BIOS, tune vendor controls, run unapproved stress or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact CBS fields, values, defaults, limits, reset type and recovery.
Perform/capture default-first and non-default persistence phases.
Interpret topology/telemetry/errors and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS tuning or overclock tools would change a different control layer and are not equivalent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the BIOS CBS workflow and use only approved read-only topology/telemetry tools with versions recorded; do not substitute runtime MSR/sysfs tuning.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first sequence, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains non-executable source wording.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every CBS field to the exact BIOS/AGESA/CPU/memory population, document safe range and affected fabric/training/topology/power behavior, then capture defaults, persistence, health and final restoration using the required reset type.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the recorded AMD platform, AGESA, CPU stepping and hardware population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, AGESA, BMC, OS/kernel and read-only inventory/telemetry tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Exact AMD/platform CBS field and recovery documentation for the implemented AGESA revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces arbitrary CBS changes with revision-bound field and consequence analysis.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds topology, training and limit evidence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field semantics, dependencies, safe matrix, reset requirements and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: CBS labels and behavior can change between AGESA releases; results cannot be generalized across revisions.

project_override_considerations: The project may approve a safe subset and explicitly omit performance/voltage/training controls. Completion applies only to the named matrix and must not claim all CBS coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform/AGESA identity, field/dependency matrix, approval and recovery
Baseline topology, training, power/thermal and hardware-error state
Load Default captures plus SPEC and health comparison
Approved non-default captures, persistence and expected consequence evidence
Final configuration, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence phases agree with the criteria. Missing field values and dependencies are readiness inputs, not conflicting source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The CBS lifecycle is identifiable. Exact revision-bound fields, limits and recovery must gate execution but do not make the master case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on the human boundary and adds AMD-specific dependency and safety controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its platform evidence and recovery improvements while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from automated observation and rejects cross-AGESA assumptions and runtime-software substitution.

review_improvement: Makes CBS changes traceable to the exact AGESA/CPU/hardware population and protects training, topology, power and thermal limits.
independent_technical_reasoning: Vendor-specific firmware interpretation, mutation and visual verification are the core test and require an engineer. Automated platform telemetry is evidence only; therefore MANUAL ONLY applies.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat CBS changes, training resets, cold boots or recovery after platform anomalies; preserve the first result and obtain engineer disposition.
